{{incomplete|needs=Info on what Décor she unlocks, if necessary; quotes}} [[File:Loblolly Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Loblolly]] '''Loblolly''' (Japanese: '''シタン''' ''Citan'') is a character in the [[Generation V]] [[core series]] {{pkmn|games}}. ==In the core series games== In {{B2W2|Pokémon Black, White,}} {{B2W2|Black 2, and White 2}}, the {{player}} may find Loblolly in the southeast section of [[Nacrene City]], where her studio is located. After visiting the {{pkmn|Dream World}} at least once, Loblolly will talk about [[Décor]] that "people will dream of". Players may choose one of five pieces of Décor that will be unlocked in the Dream World the next time the [[Game Sync]] is used. Each day, another piece may be chosen. ===Quotes=== ;Nacrene City * If talked to without visiting the Dream World :''"My name is Loblolly. I'm a designer of Décor items. But I'm stuck now... I just can't come up with a good design.
